# ethereum-optimism/superchain-ops Daily Update (Apr 10, 2026)
## OVERVIEW 
Today's development focused on addressing a critical receipt root mismatch bug affecting older chains and initiating a cleanup of unused dependencies. A new feature template for batcher and signer configuration was also introduced.

## KEY TECHNICAL DEVELOPMENTS

*   **Dependency Cleanup and Optimization:**
    *   Initiated an audit and cleanup of Go dependencies, identifying several that could be removed or consolidated. ([#19996](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-ops/issues/19996))
    *   Identified opportunities to remove unused npm dependencies, dead Docker images, and slim Python requirements. ([#20016](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-ops/issues/20016))

*   **L2ContractsManager Security Enhancement:**
    *   Resolved an issue related to potential storage variable collisions in `L2ContractsManager` when executed via `DELEGATECALL`. ([#19315](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-ops/issues/19315))

## NEWLY OPENED PULL REQUESTS
A new pull request, [#1393](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-ops/pull/1393), was opened to add a `SetBatcherAndSigner` template feature.

## CLOSED ISSUES

*   **L2ContractsManager Storage Collision Resolved:**
    *   The issue concerning potential storage variable collisions in `L2ContractsManager` was resolved. ([#19315](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-ops/issues/19315))

*   **Dependency Cleanup Opportunities Identified:**
    *   An issue detailing opportunities to remove unused npm dependencies, dead Docker images, and slim Python requirements was closed, with the work being split into separate issues. ([#20016](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-ops/issues/20016))

## NEW ISSUES
No new issues were opened today.

## ACTIVE ISSUES

*   **Receipt Root Mismatch on Older Chains ([#19930](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-ops/issues/19930)):**
    *   Discussion today focused on identifying the root cause of the receipt root mismatch. It was determined that the problem lies in `op-reth/crates/consensus/src/proof.rs`, where the receipt trie was incorrectly built using `encode_2718` for pre-Canyon op-geth rules, which require omitting the `deposit_nonce` field.
    *   A secondary issue was identified in `validation/mod.rs`, where the precomputed `receipt_root_bloom` was unconditionally trusted, allowing incorrect roots to pass validation.
    *   The proposed fix involves correcting the trie encoding with Canyon-awareness in `proof.rs` and gating the `receipt_root_bloom` shortcut to prevent its use in block validation.
    *   Further investigation confirmed the issue on other old op-stack rollups, indicating it's an upstream problem brought into the current codebase.

*   **Go Dependency Cleanup ([#19996](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-ops/issues/19996)):**
    *   The team is actively reviewing and prioritizing the identified Go dependency cleanup tasks.
    *   "High Priority" observations regarding specific dependencies were acknowledged and will be addressed.

*   **Monorepo Celebration ([#10000](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-ops/issues/10000)):**
    *   A recent comment confirmed the existence of `#20000`, indicating continued progress and milestones.
